findings.title: robots.txt Inaccessible (HTTP 403/401)
findings.evidence: Request to https://hm.com/robots.txt returned HTTP 403. AI crawlers cannot verify crawl permissions.

suggested_action.summary: Ensure robots.txt is publicly accessible with HTTP 200 status for all web agents.

findings.title: AI Crawler User-Agent Blocked by Server/WAF
findings.evidence: Requesting https://hm.com with a GPTBot User-Agent returned HTTP 403.

suggested_action.summary: Configure Cloudflare, Akamai, or edge firewall rules to allow verified AI search crawlers rather than issuing an automated 403 Forbidden.

findings.title: Non-200 Response on Primary Page Fetch
findings.evidence: GET https://hm.com returned HTTP 403.

suggested_action.summary: Investigate server errors or bot-blocking rules causing non-success responses for standard crawler requests.

findings.title: Sitemap Missing or Invalid
findings.evidence: https://hm.com/sitemap.xml returned HTTP 403 or is not a valid XML sitemap.

suggested_action.summary: Publish a valid sitemap.xml at the domain root and reference it in robots.txt.

findings.title: Content Hidden Behind Client-Side JavaScript (CSR)
findings.evidence: Raw server-rendered HTML contains only 44 visible words, with 0 script tags (0.0 KB inline JS). AI crawlers that do not execute JavaScript will see a near-empty page.

suggested_action.summary: Adopt Server-Side Rendering (SSR) or Static Site Generation (SSG) for key entity/product pages so facts exist in the raw HTML response.

findings.title: Missing Machine-Readable Structured Data (JSON-LD)
findings.evidence: Found 0 valid <script type='application/ld+json'> blocks on https://zalando.com. AI search crawlers cannot deterministically extract entities or facts.

suggested_action.summary: Add Schema.org JSON-LD markup (Organization at minimum, plus Product/FAQPage/Article where relevant) so AI engines can extract unambiguous facts.

findings.title: Missing Canonical URL Declaration
findings.evidence: Page does not declare a `<link rel='canonical'>` tag. Inconsistent URLs may cause conflicting knowledge citations across AI engines.

suggested_action.summary: Add a self-referential `<link rel='canonical' href='https://...'>` in `<head>` to establish single-source-of-truth URL indexing.

findings.title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) Header
findings.evidence: Target HTTPS origin does not broadcast a Strict-Transport-Security response header. Autonomous web scrapers and secure search indexers flag non-HSTS origins as lower transport trust.

suggested_action.summary: Configure web server or edge CDN to send 'Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains' on all HTTPS endpoints.

findings.title: Sitemap Missing or Invalid
findings.evidence: https://zalando.com/sitemap.xml returned HTTP 200 or is not a valid XML sitemap.

suggested_action.summary: Publish a valid sitemap.xml at the domain root and reference it in robots.txt.

findings.title: Buried Direct Answer Above The Fold (High Bounce Risk)
findings.evidence: No short (<=80 word) paragraph immediately follows the <h1> above the fold. AI-referred visitors must hunt for the key answer and risk bouncing.

suggested_action.summary: Place a concise 2-3 sentence direct-answer summary callout immediately below the H1 heading before any hero carousels or spacers.

findings.title: Low Text-to-HTML Ratio (Excessive DOM Bloat)
findings.evidence: Visible body text constitutes only 0.69% of the total HTML payload (333 text chars vs 48385 HTML chars). Excessive markup impairs AI token ingestion efficiency.

suggested_action.summary: Minify markup, externalize inline CSS/JS scripts, and eliminate unnecessary nested wrapper divs.

findings.title: Intrusive Modal Overlay Detected on Initial View

suggested_action.summary: Suppress disruptive popups for users arriving from AI search referrers or defer modal appearance until substantial user scroll.

findings.title: Low Text-to-HTML Ratio (Excessive DOM Bloat)
findings.evidence: Visible body text constitutes only 2.25% of the total HTML payload (6639 text chars vs 294846 HTML chars). Excessive markup impairs AI token ingestion efficiency.

suggested_action.summary: Minify markup, externalize inline CSS/JS scripts, and eliminate unnecessary nested wrapper divs.

findings.title: Content Hidden Behind Client-Side JavaScript (CSR)
findings.evidence: Raw server-rendered HTML contains only 26 visible words, with 0 script tags (0.0 KB inline JS). AI crawlers that do not execute JavaScript will see a near-empty page.

suggested_action.summary: Adopt Server-Side Rendering (SSR) or Static Site Generation (SSG) for key entity/product pages so facts exist in the raw HTML response.

findings.title: Missing Machine-Readable Structured Data (JSON-LD)
findings.evidence: Found 0 valid <script type='application/ld+json'> blocks on https://britishairways.com. AI search crawlers cannot deterministically extract entities or facts.

suggested_action.summary: Add Schema.org JSON-LD markup (Organization at minimum, plus Product/FAQPage/Article where relevant) so AI engines can extract unambiguous facts.

findings.title: Missing Temporal & Freshness Metadata
findings.evidence: https://britishairways.com exposes no article:modified_time meta tag, Last-Modified HTTP header, or dateModified/datePublished schema field. AI search engines cannot verify content recency.

suggested_action.summary: Publish machine-readable ISO-8601 timestamps in OpenGraph and Schema.org 'dateModified' metadata on all dynamic and catalog pages.

findings.title: Missing Canonical URL Declaration
findings.evidence: Page does not declare a `<link rel='canonical'>` tag. Inconsistent URLs may cause conflicting knowledge citations across AI engines.

suggested_action.summary: Add a self-referential `<link rel='canonical' href='https://...'>` in `<head>` to establish single-source-of-truth URL indexing.

findings.title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) Header

suggested_action.summary: Configure web server or edge CDN to send 'Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains' on all HTTPS endpoints.

suggested_action.summary: Publish machine-readable ISO-8601 timestamps in OpenGraph and Schema.org 'dateModified' metadata on all dynamic and catalog pages.

findings.title: Missing Canonical URL Declaration
findings.evidence: Page does not declare a `<link rel='canonical'>` tag. Inconsistent URLs may cause conflicting knowledge citations across AI engines.

suggested_action.summary: Add a self-referential `<link rel='canonical' href='https://...'>` in `<head>` to establish single-source-of-truth URL indexing.

findings.title: Sitemap URLs Lack <lastmod> Timestamps

findings.title: Missing Temporal & Freshness Metadata

findings.title: Missing Entity Disambiguation (sameAs) in Organization Schema

findings.title: FAQ Content Lacks Structured FAQPage Schema

findings.title: Sitemap URLs Lack <lastmod> Timestamps

findings.title: Buried Direct Answer Above The Fold (High Bounce Risk)

findings.title: Missing Deep-Link Target Anchors for AI Citations

findings.title: Intrusive Modal Overlay Detected on Initial View
